answer: Designated railway engineer registration with railway engineers attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because a registration engineers renew after track audits, the basalt of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the tundra first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The cipher is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
